本材质包依据 LabPBR 标准，为《丰收季节》添加了法线、视差、反射、自发光及次表面散射效果。
使用前请阅读 [SPBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spbr)![次表面散射](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0c48cc66929977ed015a1ae3c45c5517f656017.jpeg) 注意事项；建议搭配使用 [SPBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spbr)![法线、反射与视差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/546cd1bd3681068871cdc0d59fd1383bedd327d2_0.webp)![次表面散射](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c8cf51f42ed3f465b376c2c0c32b94decfe3ac8_0.webp)![模型重制](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d19a61b89a607ce55869860c82b1110b48381e0.jpeg)![法线与视差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a6c5c8a703c23104052cbdfe35eef21cea4560a.jpeg)![法线与视差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8110e06119c17413ed21ed1b7e8a460aa7c1fd5c.jpeg)。
